fact: Car 30 was released from a pit stop in an unsafe condition.
offence: Breach of Article 34.14 d) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. The car was released from a pit stop with the front left wheel not fastened correctly. The car continued on track for one lap and then returned to the pits to have the wheel fastened correctly.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
